official: 杉並区小児慢性特定疾病審査会条例

sources.label: 令和8年第2回定例会 議案・議決結果の一覧

name: 小児慢性特定疾病の審査会のルールを定める
summary: 小児慢性特定疾病の医療費の支給を認定しないときは、審査会に審査を求める決まりがあります。この議案では、杉並区に置く審査会の委員数や会議のルール、報酬を定めます。2026年11月1日から施行します。
changes: 審査会を委員6人以内で構成する
会議を非公開とし、委員の半数以上の出席で開く
委員に退任後も職務上の秘密を守る義務を課す
会長の報酬を日額21,000円、委員の報酬を日額18,500円とする
who: 小児慢性特定疾病の医療費を申請し、支給が認定されない見込みの人
why: 杉並区が児童相談所設置市に指定され、区の審査会について定める必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Sets rules for the pediatric chronic specified disease review committee
en.official: Suginami City Pediatric Chronic Specified Disease Review Committee Ordinance
en.summary: When payment of medical expenses for pediatric chronic specified diseases is not approved, the rules require that a review be requested from a review committee. This bill sets the number of members, meeting rules, and compensation for the committee established in Suginami City. It takes effect on November 1, 2026.
changes: Limits the committee to no more than 6 members
Requires meetings to be closed to the public and held with at least half of the members present
Requires members to keep information learned through their duties confidential even after leaving office
Sets daily compensation at ¥21,000 for the chair and ¥18,500 for members
who: People who apply for medical expense benefits for pediatric chronic specified diseases and are expected to be denied
en.why: The ward says this is because Suginami City has been designated a city that operates a child guidance center, and rules need to be established for the City's review committee.
